arguments.command: export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug3"; RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; HOME_DIR="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; rm -f "$RUN_LOG"; rm -f "$FIFO"; mkdir -p "$HOME_DIR/.config" "$HOME_DIR/.local/share"; mkfifo "$FIFO"; nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < "$FIFO" > "$RUN_LOG" 2>&1 & sleep 2; ls -la "$RUN_LOG"; tail -n 20 "$RUN_LOG" || true
